description: AI capture can create multiple transaction drafts from one text chat while preserving single-transaction behavior.
verification: Input like 'beli kopi 25rb, sarapan 15rb, parkir 5rb' must create three transaction drafts with appropriate categories.

description: Receipt scan can create one transaction draft per readable receipt item and categorize items by product name.
verification: A receipt extraction with multiple items must produce multiple drafts whose amounts, categories, merchant, and date remain accurate.

description: Manual transaction create/edit form uses the iOS-style wheel date picker with explicit date confirmation.
verification: Manual transaction screen must render the wheel picker and save the confirmed date.

description: Text classifier and backend fallback parse Indonesian natural-language dates and strip date text from notes.
verification: Inputs like 'Beli kopi 1rb tanggal 01 Juni 2026' and 'beli susu 15rb tgl 2/6/2026' must store ISO dates and clean notes.

description: Reports screen keeps custom period wheel pickers and saved monthly cycle rule controls.
verification: Reports period modal must expose start/end wheel pickers and saved-rule controls.

description: Bills remain integrated into the existing Transactions flow through chips/cards, not as an extra tab.
verification: Transactions screen must keep the Bills chip/filter path and bill creation entry points.

description: Home dashboard preserves privacy/theme toggles, active period label, and main financial summary cards.
verification: Home dashboard must render privacy/theme controls, active period, total balance, monthly remaining, expense, hero, and budget sections.

description: In-app notification bell, unread badge, mark-all-read action, and empty state stay available.
verification: Notification bell/badge and notification screen actions must remain in the PWA bundle.

description: Reports AI insight and recommendation entry cards remain present for the freemium AI monetization flow.
verification: Reports must continue to render AI insight entry points and the AI insight card.

description: Transactions screen respects the active report period and renders period context rows.
verification: Transactions screen must show active period context and avoid losing period filter UI.

description: Dashboard shows transaction review CTA and transactions screen supports review filter when transactions need cleanup.
verification: Dashboard must render review CTA when count>0, transactions must show 'Perlu dicek' filter chip, and the review filter must hide clean transactions.
